data.plainLyric:
Like an empty fire
Like your desire
Like an empty fire
Stand tall, go higher
And on and on and on and on and I say

Ooh-oh, ooh-oh, ooh-oh-oh
Ooh-oh, ooh-oh, ooh-oh-oh

We stand united through the storm (hey, hey, hey, hey, hey)
Lay all your love right on my door (hey, hey, hey, hey, hey)
I'll never fall, I'm standing tall (hey, hey, hey, hey, hey)
Go take the darkness out my heart (hey, hey, hey, hey, hey)

Girl, I know it may hurt
But it won't last forever
And on and on and on and on and on and I say

Feels likе a drug, drug, drug
We gonna love, love, love
Until the sun comes up, up
You're all on the luck, luck, luck
We don't give a fuck 'bout what's
It's only a nick of time
When you see the stars, you better run (and I see)

I stand together through it all (and you feel)
Your desires is my only fall (hey, hey, hey, hey, hey)

Girl, I know it may hurt
But it won't last forever

And I see your love, your tears
And you fill my soul with tears

Until the sun comes up, up
